theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_integrable_smooth_ext
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Eucl P)) (g₁ g₂ : Eucl P → ℝ), Integrable g₁ μ₁ → Integrable g₂ μ₂ → ∀ O : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen O → (∀ ψ : Eucl P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ O → ∫ x, ψ x * g₁ x ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, ψ x * g₂ x ∂μ₂) → ∀ b : Eucl P → ℝ, Measurable b → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, |b x| ≤ C) → (∀ x, x ∉ O → b x = 0) → ∫ x, b x * g₁ x ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, b x * g₂ x ∂μ₂
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
